Negative Vote.note: The player the Thief chooses, never themself; dead players allowed.

setupPrep.none: its tokens mark what a player chooses at night, placed when they choose

reminderMovement.why: Placed on a new choice each night.

full.text: The Thief chooses a player: move *NEGATIVE VOTE* to them.
full.reason: Says last night’s Negative Vote token comes off.
